integrity: The universal argument is analytic and algebraic. The bundled finite computation is corroborative only and is not used to infer the theorem for untested primes.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns nonzero cubic-residue frequencies in prime cyclic groups and endpoint norms only. It does not determine interior operator norms or the distribution of the arithmetic branch as the prime varies. Classical cyclotomy is extensive, so equivalent terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact cubic-residue Lebesgue constants from Gaussian period arithmetic
